description:
Gillian Milne, Re/max City & Shire is delighted to bring to the open market A superb opportunity to acquire this well-presented two-bedroom maisonette nestled in the highly sought-after AB10 6JJ postcode, offering comfortable and stylish living within easy reach of local amenities, transport links and excellent schooling options, , this property is ideal for first-time buyers, professionals or families alike.

The accommodation is thoughtfully arranged across two levels. On the ground floor you’ll find a brightlounge offering flexible space for everyday living. The kitchen/dining area is a real highlight, spacious enough to accommodate a dining table for family meals and entertaining, with plenty of storage and work surfaces for practical use. Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom. Gas central heating and double glazing ensure efficient, comfortable living throughout the year.

Externally, the property boasts a single garage, perfect for secure parking or extra storage, as well as communal parking space for residents and visitors. A private garden to the front provides an outdoor retreat for relaxing and gardening.

Educational provision is a key benefit of this location. Within easy reach are well-regarded local primary schools including Broomhill Primary School and Ashley Road School, both serving the community and providing quality early years education. Airyhall School and Kaimhill Primary School are also nearby options for primary pupils. For older children, Harlaw Academy and Aberdeen Grammar School are prominent local secondary schools providing broad curriculums and extracurricular opportunities within the Aberdeen City Council area.

The property benefits from excellent local services, shops and eateries, while being well connected to Aberdeen city centre and surrounding districts.

All floor coverings, window dressings, and white goods are included in the sale.
